title: CSM plan suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority planning preferences for the csm-plan namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only presentation verbosity and phase batching size are configurable; plan schema identity, activation boundaries, R&D sandbox containment, lifecycle, credentials, and write scope are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

verbosity.description: Presentation verbosity of plan reporting; never changes contracts or side effects.

batchSize.description: Preferred number of plan tasks grouped per planning batch (1-20).
